syntax: SUM(points) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW)
summary: A window frame can exclude the current row after its boundaries are established.
documentation: A window frame can exclude the current row after its boundaries are established. Summing a full team partition with EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW gives each row the total of other rows, without a self join or subtracting its own possibly NULL value.
inputs: scores(id INTEGER, team TEXT NOT NULL, points INTEGER).
returns: id, team and other_points, ordered by team then id.
caution: SUM ignores NULL points and returns NULL when no contributing numeric rows remain. Excluding the current row differs from excluding all tied peers.
scenarios: Compare an individual contribution with the rest of a team.
Show the total value of other items in a grouped quote.
Calculate leave-one-out totals in a local analysis report.
title: Sum the other contributions
problem: For each score, return id, team and the sum of all other rows in that team AS other_points. Use a full-partition ROWS frame with EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW. Preserve SUM’s NULL behavior and order by team, id.
hint: Exclude the row in the frame; subtracting from a total mishandles NULL points.
goal: Use EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
